author: dreever
notes_extra: 175 OTM. 24 in Gap Hospitaller. Magazine length, he wrote 2.900 max and OAL 2.880. ES not given on this post. The 185 BTLR charge in the same post is a different bullet. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is for 308.

author: dreever
notes_extra: He wrote .308. Max magazine length OAL 2.885. ES of 15 fps. He called it a conservative load. This is a later chronograph of the same charge weight.

author: DogPatch06
notes_extra: 24 in 1:11.25 twist. COAL 2.806. Single digit ES and SD. He did not name the cartridge; he was answering dreever's .308 post.

author: Bob L Swagger
notes_extra: Berger 175 OTM's. Gradous Surgeon, 20 in 1:10 .299/.308 Bartlein. New Lapua brass. Seated .030 out of the lands. Three-shot group at 300 yards. No velocity.

author: Alaska
notes_extra: He wrote 2.810 and 308 Winchester. No velocity.
